blocks.heading: Manufacturing Interlining Fabric in Delhi Since 1977
blocks.intro: From a small cloth trading counter in 1977 to a full-scale interlining manufacturer — this is the story of the business garment makers and buying houses still call directly today.

blocks.html:
1977
Year Founded
Our Story

From A Small Trading Counter To A Manufacturer

Jai Baba Nanak Cloth Trading Co. began in 1977 as a small cloth trading counter in Delhi. There was no factory behind it at first — just a family willing to source fabric honestly and deliver what was promised, on the day it was promised.

Over the decades, that trading counter grew into in-house manufacturing. Machines were added as demand grew, product lines were built one at a time, and the business moved from simply trading cloth to producing it — buckram, fusible interlining, pocketing cloth, readymade collar & cuff, belt roll & placket (patti), shoulder pads, EVA foam, woven & knitted elastics, tatron and velcro tape. Buckram alone moves through every channel we operate — manufactured for garment units and supplied in bulk to wholesalers and traders alike.

The company remains family-run to this day. It is now guided by the next generation of the Chawla family, and our sales team handles orders, specifications and dispatch for garment manufacturers and buying houses.

  • Family-owned since 1977, now in its next generation of leadership
  • Grew from trading to full in-house manufacturing
  • Same direct, no-middleman relationship with buyers since day one
blocks.label: From A Small Trading Counter To A Manufacturer

blocks.heading: Consistent Fabric, Order After Order
blocks.subtitle: Our mission has not changed since 1977 — supply garment makers with interlining they can build a production schedule around.

items.title: Reliable, Repeatable Quality
items.text: The roll you reorder should match the roll you first tested — every time, not just on the first order.

items.title: Direct Manufacturer Relationships
items.text: Buyers deal with the people who make their fabric, not a chain of agents and resellers.

items.title: Dispatch You Can Plan Around
items.text: A confirmed delivery date is a commitment, not an estimate — production schedules depend on us keeping it.

blocks.heading: Where We're Headed
blocks.subtitle: Growth for us means going deeper into interlining manufacturing, not spreading thin across unrelated categories.

items.title: Deeper Manufacturing Capability
items.text: Continued investment in our Delhi production floor, not diversification away from what we know.

items.title: Wider Export Reach
items.text: Extending the same manufacturer-direct relationship to more export buying houses and merchants.

items.title: A Business Built To Outlast Us
items.text: Passing a family business to the next generation with the same standards it was built on.

blocks.heading: What Guides Every Order We Ship

items.title: Consistency Over Cleverness
items.text: We would rather hold a specification steady across a thousand metres than experiment mid-order.

items.title: Straight Dealing
items.text: Clear pricing, honest lead times, and no surprises buried in the fine print of an order.

items.title: Ownership
items.text: If a batch falls short of specification, we own the problem and fix it — not the buyer's production schedule.

blocks.heading: A Factory Built Up Step By Step Over Decades
blocks.html:
Our manufacturing capability wasn't set up in a single investment — it was added to gradually, decade after decade, as the business earned the right to grow. Each machine, each process checkpoint, was added because a buyer needed it, not because it looked good on paper.

That gradual build-up is why our manufacturing process is as stable as it is today. Nothing on our floor is untested at scale, and every product category we run has years of production history behind it.

Leadership

Family-Run, Now In Its Next Generation

The Chawla family still runs the business, and a dedicated sales team looks after customer enquiries and orders.

blocks.imageAlt: Production infrastructure at the Jaibaba Interlinings Delhi facility
blocks.heading: A Delhi Facility Set Up For Repeat, Bulk Production
blocks.html: Our infrastructure is built around one goal: repeatability at volume. Raw material intake, production, in-line checks and packing are laid out as a continuous flow, so a bulk order doesn't get treated any differently from a small one — it just runs longer.
checklist: Dedicated production lines for each core product category
In-line width, weight and bond checkpoints during every run
Packing and storage set up for both domestic dispatch and export

Milestones

Since 1977, In Brief

1977

Started As A Cloth Trading Counter

Jai Baba Nanak Cloth Trading Co. began trading cloth in Delhi, building relationships one order at a time.

Early Years

Expansion Into In-House Manufacturing

The business moved beyond trading and began producing interlining fabric on its own floor.

Growth Years

Broadened Into 10 Core Product Categories

Buckram, fusible interlining, pocketing cloth, readymade collar & cuff, belt roll & placket (patti), shoulder pads, EVA foam, woven & knitted elastics, tatron and velcro tape were added to the range.

Later Years

Began Serving Export Buying Houses

Domestic supply extended into export documentation and container-ready bulk shipments.

Today

In Continuous Operation Since 1977

Now guided by the next generation of the Chawla family, manufacturing ten interlining product lines from Delhi for garment makers, wholesalers and traders across India and abroad.
